name: Downtown Spirit of Christmas Walk
address: Downtown Grand Junction, Grand Junction, CO 81501
paras: Downtown Grand Junction hosts the Spirit of Christmas Walk on Friday, December 11, 2026, from 5:30 to 8:30 PM. Downtown becomes a Christmas village with extended business hours and extra entertainment along the walk.
The host lists walking light tours, special shopping deals, carolers, pop-up art markets, entertainment and a Santa Con. The walk is a public downtown event with no admission listed.
tip: Dress warmly and plan to walk, since the lights, carolers and pop-up markets are spread along downtown.

name: Olde Fashioned Christmas in Palisade
when_note: Friday, December 4, 4:30 to 6:30 PM and Saturday, December 5, 10 AM to 4 PM
paras: The Palisade Chamber of Commerce runs Olde Fashioned Christmas in downtown Palisade on Friday, December 4, and Saturday, December 5, 2026. Friday evening, from 4:30 to 6:30 PM, brings a cup of warmth at Slice O'Life Bakery, a carolers march at 3rd and Main, the Palisade Parade of Lights at 5:30 PM, the tree lighting and the tower lighting at the Palisade Fire Station at 6 PM.

Saturday runs from 10 AM to 4 PM with a Winter Faire of artisan booths, food and music, Clark's Carriage Rides from 10:30 AM to 3:30 PM, the Candy Cane Train and Depot at 3rd and Main from 10 AM to 4 PM, and Christmas Critters at 2nd and Peach from 10 AM to 2 PM. Pictures with Santa are at 3rd and Kluge from 11 AM to 12:30 PM, with Galasso Images photo packages starting at $25.

The Winter Faire is free to attend. A ticketed Breakfast with Santa on Saturday at 8:30 or 9:00 AM adds a buffet, a professional photo with Santa, a free book and a candy cane, with tickets sold through Zeffy. The weekend also includes a children's Gingerbread Contest and Showcase with drop off at 9 AM on December 5 and a Soup Challenge from 11 AM to 1:30 PM.
tip: Arrive Friday for the 5:30 PM parade or Saturday before 11 AM to line up for Santa pictures.

name: Christmas at Cross
cost: $5 per person, free for museum members
paras: The Museums of Western Colorado hold Christmas at Cross on Saturday, December 19, 2026, from 9 AM to 3 PM at the Cross Orchards Historic Site, 3073 Patterson Road in Grand Junction. Admission is $5 per person and free for museum members.
The day includes unlimited firetruck and train rides, visits with Santa, crafts, hot cocoa, cider and cookies, and a model train Christmas show. Tickets are sold through the museum's ticketing page.
tip: Buy tickets ahead and head to the train and firetruck lines first, since rides are unlimited all day.
